verdict.rationale: The CLI has an `experimental_install` command that restores skills from a skills-lock.json lockfile. Updates only happen when you run `skills update`, explicitly for all or named skills. Project-scope installs are committed with the repo and shared with the team, so changes reach teammates through version control rather than silently. The lockfile path is labeled experimental, and there is no documented syntax for pinning a version or ref. A community comment complains that pinning is undocumented, but it is a general question rather than a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: a stable (non-experimental) lockfile workflow, explicit version/ref pinning syntax, documentation of lockfile contents and update semantics, and hands-on corroboration.
